يستأصل (form X)
# يَسْتَأْصِلُ (yastaʔṣilu) /jas.taʔ.sˤi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# يُسْتَأْصَلُ (yustaʔṣalu) /jus.taʔ.sˤa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# يَسْتَأْصِلَ (yastaʔṣila) /jas.taʔ.sˤi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
